name: laeral silverhand
lore:
To encounter Laeral Silverhand is to stand before the living history of the North. As Open Lord of Waterdeep, she occupies the apex of urban civilization, her presence as vital to the City of Splendors as the stone of Mount Waterdeep itself. Though she wears the guise of a regal stateswoman, do not be deceived; she is a Chosen of Mystra, her very soul entwined with the silver threads of the Weave.

In behavior, the Lady Mage is a study in tempered majesty. She moves with a fluid grace that defies her centuries, speaking with a voice like aged wine—smooth, yet heady with authority. She prefers the subtle shift of the diplomatic lens to the thunder of the spellstaff, yet should the city’s peace be threatened, her wrath is as precise and devastating as a starfall. She remains the calm, silver eye of the Sword Coast’s storm.
